algorithm.description: Exponential moving average over a time series of prices.
steps: Validate the price series is sorted by date
Compute the EMA using the specified span
Flag crossover points where the price crosses the EMA

prices.units: array of {date, close} with close in the asset's currency

span.effect: Shorter spans react faster to price changes but produce more noise. Longer spans are smoother but lag behind.

ema.interpretation: The smoothed price level at each date. Compare against the raw close to identify trend direction.

crossovers.interpretation: Dates where the price crossed the EMA. 'bullish' means price crossed above; 'bearish' means price crossed below.

errors.when: price series has fewer data points than span
errors.hint: Fetch a longer price history or reduce the span.
